answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in wharf, checked in wander, and ridge reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1722 identities would post 2750 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
